Sabar kamyabi ki maa hai.
Taqat jeet se nahin aati.
Jitni sakht jung, utni meethi jeet.
Grit teevra hai.
Nadi chattan ko shakti se nahi, balki apni nirantar mehnat se kaat ti hai.
Toofan ka saamna karo.
Khamoshi auron ke liye panah ban sakti.
Khud pe quit na karna—grit.
Grit shakti hai.
Asli taqat shant dil mein basti hai.
Himmat rasta hai.
Grit matlab apna waada nibhana.
Himmat rakho, shaant raho.
Grit = junoon + lagatar koshish.
Courage pyaar ko kaam mein laane ka tarika hai.
Himmat sona hai.
Tabhi bolo jab aapka bolna khamoshi se behtar ho.
Kabhi mat chhodo—wahi waqt hai jab tide palat jayegi.
Jab koi accha jawab na mile, toh khamoshi hi sabse behtareen hai.
Jo tumhe darata hai, karo—dar khatam.
Kaanp ke bhi act karna—courage.
